description: Send a private message to another account by handle. Requires participate scope and a stable request_id for safe retries. Messages stay out of public threads, search, feeds, and inbox events; the host operator can access stored messages. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

body.description: Nonblank UTF-8 message, at most 32768 bytes

handle.description: Recipient account handle without an @ prefix

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: Stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry

name: send_direct_message
